lines: 「You have done well to reach my mansion. I bid you welcome, flies.」
The Lady of the Spiders had shown herself.
They could tell at a glance that that was who she was.
A gaze which, contrary to her welcoming words, didn't give the slightest impression of warmth.
Pale skin that looked to have never bathed in sunlight even once.
And above all else, eight spider legs in four pairs, sprouting from her back, which looked like that of a human woman.
Just from her having come in, it felt as though the temperature of the room had dropped.
Mitsuki
「Are you the Spider Lady-san?」
Lady of the Spiders
「Insolent flies, aren't you, to not even kneel when you ask something from me?」
Lady of the Spiders
「But I shall have mercy, and forgive the doings of benighted insects. I am as you say.」
The Lady of the Spiders moved her lips, which were devoid of any colour.
Mutsuho snorted at her speaking style, which was like the very picture of haughtiness.
Mutsuho
「That's a funny joke, for a spider monster to be calling humans bugs.」
Lady of the Spiders
「You there. You smell.」
The Lady knit her eyebrows slightly.
Mutsuho
「Huh?」
Lady of the Spiders
「You smell of poisons, mixed together indiscriminately. How vile. It would appear you are most unsuitable for my manor.」
She moved one of her spider legs, and held her nose like something was truly foul.
Mutsuho
「Oh, good. I'd rather not have a spider monster take a liking to me, after all.」
Mutsuho's face was smiling, but her eyes were not.
She was already slowly exuding poison from her palms, in anger over her ability having been insulted.
While gently reining Mutsuho in with her hand so that she wouldn't jump the gun, Mitsuki first inquired about Homura's wellbeing.
Mitsuki
「I believe a person named Sanada Homura has been sold to you.」
Mitsuki
「Where is she now? Is she alive? Please answer.」
Lady of the Spiders
「I would not know.」
The Lady of the Spiders curtly replied.
Mitsuki
「Please don't lie. I've heard that you bought her at a slave auction from someone called Bosluk.」
Lady of the Spiders
「I do not remember the name of every little insect I use to procure my daily energy.」
The Lady of the Spiders said, uninterestedly.
Her face said that she was not dodging the question, but genuinely didn't care.
Mitsuki
For her not to even know whether Homura was alive or dead...
Lady of the Spiders
「Shigemori, what do you know?」
The Lady of the Spiders suddenly turned around behind her and asked.
Shigemori
「You did indeed purchase her, Oku-sama. Sanada Homura. She is a Taimanin.」
A man had appeared, slipping out of the shadows where no one had been until now.
A butler, perhaps? He was wearing a black tuxedo, and had white gloves on his hands.
And like her before him, his eyes were cold, his skin was pale, and no human warmth could be sensed from him.
Due to Shigemori's answer, the Spider Lady nodded like she understood.
Lady of the Spiders
「Oh, that one? The one that harboured something of the demonic within it, despite it only being a measly fly.」
Lady of the Spiders
「Its life essence was most delectable. You made a fine purchase, Shigemori.」
Shigemori
「I am most pleased that you enjoyed it.」
Shigemori was politely bowing his head, but their exchange just now could not be overlooked.
Mitsuki
「Wha?! You sucked up Sanada-san's life energy?! Have you killed her?!!」
Mitsuki pressed her firmly, but the Lady and her butler didn't even try to look at her.
Lady of the Spiders
「But, there was still a touch of the bitter flavour of the lower orders left in it. I believe you hung it up to remove that taste, yes?」
Shigemori
「Indeed. I expect she will be good for eating soon.」
Lady of the Spiders
「I shall be looking forward to it.」
Perhaps an expression of anticipation, the Lady of the Spiders was rubbing her eight legs together.
Rin
「It sounds like her life essence has been absorbed, but she's still alive.」
Rin concluded calmly, but Mitsuki couldn't remain anything like calm.
Mitsuki
「Please, enough already! What do you think people are?!!」
Mitsuki
「Spider Lady-san! I'm talking to you! Look at me!!」
Wind kicked up around her in a surge of violent anger.
Subjected to that wind, the Lady of the Spiders finally looked at Mitsuki again.
Lady of the Spiders
「What? Are you still here? You may take your leave now.」
Lady of the Spiders
「Take those pungent flies away at once.」
She waved her hand as if literally shooing a fly.
Mitsuki
「I'm afraid we can't do that. We're going to defeat you and head back with Sanada-san.」
Mitsuki
「And the other people you're holding captive, too! Please prepare yourself!!」
With a snap, Mitsuki pointed the end of her fan at her, but the Lady of the Spiders said, as though this were tiresome,
Lady of the Spiders
「Obstinate flies. Shigemori, I shall leave the rest to you.」
Shigemori
「Certainly.」
Lady of the Spiders
「Without killing that noisy one. I should like to see what flavour it has.」
Lady of the Spiders
「The one that smells of poison, dispose of so that none of its odour remains. The other, you may do with as you please.」
Shigemori
「In that event, I will make her my new puppet.」
Lady of the Spiders
「That is fine. Also, for heaven's sake, could you quiet the ruckus above?」
Lady of the Spiders
「Change is occasionally necessary in one's dull everyday life, but not so noisy as this.」
Shigemori
「I do apologize. As soon as I have dealt with these people.」
Lady of the Spiders
「After I have taken my nap, shall I eat that Taimanin?」
After once again ignoring Mitsuki and the others, and speaking selfishly, the Lady of the Spiders yawned, and tried to leave the dining room.
Mitsuki
「Wait!!」
Shigemori
「I will not allow you to disturb Oku-sama.」
Without a sound, Shigemori blocked the way in front of Mitsuki, who tried to chase after her.
What was more, armed women appeared in droves from the many doors leading to the dining room.
Mitsuki
「An ambush?!」
Mutsuho
「Looks like we fell into the trap this time.」
Rin
「Here they come!」
